title: Verification → evidence for your review
summary: Python: files exist; matching code revision; commands really ran; references preserved; allowed scope and limits.
body:
Python: files exist; matching code revision; commands really ran; references preserved; allowed scope and limits.

Jev: narrow obligations with actual evidence; SATISFIED / VIOLATED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

Example: removed bullet still counted? final selected content used? requirement weakened? unrelated behavior changed?

Jev does not execute commands, grant scope expansion or certify arbitrary code from a diff.

Missing evidence calls for that evidence, not a rewrite. Technical results are separate from your acceptance.
